_comment: Blocked C38 entry recipe for sit.c:special_throne_effect case 10. From the main dungeon, teleport.c:level_tele rejects the direct Vlad's Tower name because dungeon.c:lev_by_name only resolves branch destinations in the current dungeon branch; the input remained at the level prompt and later numeric input teleported elsewhere. A matching Tower-level route is required before this caller can be evidenced.
